svg.aria-label: Map showing coffee sourced across the world's growing regions in South America, Central America, East Africa and South and Southeast Asia, arriving in Europe primarily through the Adriatic ports of Trieste, Koper and Rijeka, with Genoa, Antwerp, Hamburg, Tallinn and Gdansk also in regular use

g.text: Shaded areas mark coffee-growing countries — sourcing is not limited to any fixed list.
